prompt:
Recompose image ONE to make the farewell story instantly readable. Its current staging is REJECTED because the cow, rope, hero, man and toast read as unrelated actions. Keep the same exact character designs/painterly palette/cow identity, but rebuild positions and acting. Images TWO to FIVE are the exact hero, chief, Song Jinbao and Youbai identities. One focal event only: THE COW STEALS A BUNCH OF GRASS FROM THE DEPARTING HERO'S BASKET.
Camera medium-wide three-quarter village gate scene, open sunlit road leads to the RIGHT. Hero on RIGHT just outside gate, body facing along the road, turns his HEAD back toward his basket in comic surprise. His NEAR hand holds his FRONT shoulder strap to steady the basket; do not contort an arm behind his back. Other hand stays naturally lowered, exactly two hands total. A single bunch of LONG BROAD GREEN GRASS hangs visibly from the OUTSIDE of basket at center frame. The brown cow, at CENTER LEFT on all four feet, stretches its muzzle gently toward basket and clearly holds the OTHER END of that same grass bunch in its mouth. The visible continuous grass makes cause/effect unmistakable. Cow has exactly TWO horns/two ears and cream muzzle, gentle eyes, same approved design.
Song Jinbao is FAR LEFT beside the COW'S NECK. He holds the loose lead close to the halter with ONE hand, other hand gently steadying the halter cheek strap; laughing toward the cow's mouth. ALL rope stays in the LEFT side between cow neck and Song. NO rope crosses behind or in front of hero, NO tug-of-war, no rope around human body. Song is helping the departing hero, not pulling him.
The Tusi chief stays BEHIND them INSIDE doorway, a smaller calm observer with toast CUP LOWERED at WAIST and staff held upright, laughing while looking directly at the same cow-and-grass event. Not lifting a cup overhead or addressing an unrelated crowd. Youbai floats above the basket, looking down and laughing at the stolen grass. ALL four characters' eyelines converge on cow's mouth/grass. Clearly separate silhouettes and naturally supported limbs. Mild affectionate comedy after successful village help, no fighting or panicked running. No extra villagers, food piles, text or UI. Quiet broad warm paper and muted architectural shapes. 3:1 panoramic banner.
